title: Find the remaining number of people after grouping
goal: Use the remainder to calculate how many people are still in groups after the volunteers are divided into groups.
summary: % returns the remainder of division. When the division is complete, the remainder will be 0. When the total number of people is less than one group, the remainder is the total number of people.
tasks: In the curly brackets of ungroupedCount, volunteers are allocated into groups according to groupSize, and % is used to find the number of people who are not in a complete group.
uses return to return the remainder. The number of volunteers can be 0, and the number of volunteers in each group is a positive integer.
hint: The total number of people is written on the left side of %, and the number of people in each group is written on the right side. How much is left after dividing is determined by the remainder.
